limitations: Equal probability shell masses, two distinct concentric radii in dimension three, real radial zeros; local complex splitting at fixed resonances only. No claims on all complex zeros, unequal masses, other dimensions or parameter-uniform estimates.
scientific_integrity: An elementary full-parameter proof is provided. Numerical tests supplement but do not replace it. Earlier foundational transform results are credited. Publication priority remains subject to inspection of older literature. No external validation has been conducted.
title: Arithmetic triple Fourier nulls and cubic-root splitting for two concentric spherical shells
